attestations.text: KAO Chieh 高傑 (T. 英吾), d. 1645, Feb. 9?, bandit chief (as such called 翻山鷂), and later Ming loyalist, was a native of Mi-chih, Shensi, home of the rebel Li Tzŭ-ch'êng [q. v.], with whom, as co-leader, he pillaged throughout their native province.
